name: Do I need a building permit to remove a shower in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit to remove a shower in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver and surrounding communities like Centennial and Parker, permit requirements depend on whether the removal alters plumbing, electrical wiring, or load-bearing framing. A simple tear-out of a surface surround without changing pipe locations or structural components often does not trigger a permit on its own. However, if removing the shower involves relocating drain stacks, updating supply lines, or modifying wall framing, local municipal building departments typically require a plumbing or building permit. Checking local jurisdictional rules before beginning ensures your project remains fully compliant.
acceptedAnswer.description: Demolition alone rarely needs a permit, but relocating drains, altering water supply piping, or changing structural wall framing generally requires municipal permits.
